title: pka-helper: membrane-aware pKa prediction
description:
pka-helper predicts pKa values and protonation states of Asp, Glu, His, Lys and Arg in membrane and soluble proteins. It starts from PROPKA and lets a Poisson–Boltzmann calculation in an explicit membrane model adjust each value only as far as benchmarks justify, and gives an error estimate for every group.

Alpha release. DelPhiPKa is not included: the installer downloads it from its authors and applies pka-helper's patch. The archive includes the benchmark structures, reference values and script to reproduce the reported numbers.
